item.description:
Everything connects back to this game. This one cancelled Saturn project from 1996 is the root of every single thing that went wrong.

Sega made a deal with a demon. While they were drowning in development hell on Sonic X-treme they seemed to have reached out to something they had no business contacting. The terms were probably something along the lines of finishing the game, shipping it and becoming successful, or something horrible would occur. They failed. Key people on the team got so
